# SuperTube

> Free, open-source Android app to watch YouTube without ads, with SponsorBlock, downloads, background play and a touch interface. Also for Android TV, with a lite mode for slow TVs.

SuperTube plays videos with no ads, skips the sponsor segments for you and gives you an interface made for your fingers on the phone and for the remote on the TV. It is an independent fork of SmartTube by yuliskov (MIT license), not affiliated with Google or YouTube.

## Apps

- Phone and tablet: Material 3 with light and dark themes. A bottom bar on phones and a navigation rail on tablets and foldables. Double tap to jump 10 s, hold for 2×. Swipe up for fullscreen, down for the mini player. Brightness and volume with a swipe in fullscreen.
- Android TV and Google TV: Big rows for the remote, with the cover of the video you are on filling the background. Background image of the focused video. Lite mode for cheap TVs and TV boxes. Your subscriptions and history on the big screen.

## Features

- Videos without ads: Videos start straight away. SponsorBlock skips sponsor segments and intros, and the seek bar marks where they are.
- Keeps playing: A mini player while you browse, picture-in-picture when you leave the app, and audio with the screen off with lock-screen controls.
- Downloads: Save the audio or the video up to 1080p, seeing the size before you choose. Pause, resume, and Wi-Fi only if you want.
- Favorites in folders: Keep videos in your own folders, play them in order or shuffled, and see them on a home-screen widget.
- Your account, if you want: Sign in for your subscriptions, history and playlists. Or don't: browsing and playing work without an account.
- Lite mode for TV: One switch turns off background images, card previews and animations so a modest TV box stays smooth.

## Privacy

SuperTube has no server of its own, no analytics and no advertising code. Your settings, favorites and downloads stay on your device. Videos come straight from YouTube, so those requests are handled by Google under its own privacy policy.

## Install on a phone or tablet

1. Download: Tap “For phone and tablet” to download the APK.
2. Allow the install: Android asks once to let your browser install apps. Accept it.
3. Open and watch: No account needed. Later updates arrive from Settings › SuperTube.

## Install on a TV

1. Install Downloader: On the TV, install the free Downloader app (by AFTVnews) from the app store.
2. Type the address: Open it and type gestal.es/supertube/tv. The TV app downloads by itself.
3. Allow and install: Let Downloader install apps when Android asks. Later updates arrive from Settings › About.

## FAQ

- Is it free? Yes. No ads, no subscriptions and no in-app purchases. The source code is on GitHub under the MIT license.
- Is it an official YouTube app? No. SuperTube is an independent project, not affiliated with Google or YouTube. It is built on SmartTube, an open-source client.
- Why isn't it on Google Play? Google Play doesn't accept apps like this one, so it is published as an APK on this page and in the GitHub releases, with the signing certificate listed in the README.
- Is it legal to use? The app is legal open-source software. YouTube's Terms of Service don't allow third-party clients or ad blocking, and downloading can infringe copyright unless you have the rights or your law allows it. How you use it is your decision and your responsibility.
- Do I need an account? No. Sign in only if you want your subscriptions, history and playlists. The session is stored on your device.
- Does it work with Chromecast or Android Auto? No. SuperTube doesn't include Google Play Services, which those features need.
- Is there an iPhone version? No. SuperTube is for Android 8.0 or newer, on phones, tablets and Android TV.
- Which file is for my TV? The “For Android TV” button and the address gestal.es/supertube/tv give you the universal TV APK, which works on every TV. Each release also has smaller files per processor: arm64-v8a for recent TVs and armeabi-v7a for older ones. The phone APK isn't made for a remote, and the TV one isn't made for touch screens.
